title: External API integration
planning: Create one server-side provider adapter that validates configuration and normalizes remote payloads into an internal type.
Define timeout, cancellation, retry, rate-limit, cache, pagination, and partial-failure behavior before adding UI consumers.
Validate symbols, identifiers, date ranges, and other user-controlled values before placing them into provider URLs.
Keep credentials server-only and avoid logging secrets, full upstream payloads, or sensitive customer data.
checks: Test malformed provider payloads, missing credentials, non-2xx responses, timeout, rate limiting, empty data, and partial provider outage.
Assert bounded request counts and pagination termination with deterministic mocked responses.
Verify cached or fallback data carries timestamp and provenance so stale values are not silently presented as current.
review: Reject repeated provider-fetch logic across routes, unbounded sequential calls, arbitrary delays as rate-limit control, and zero-filled placeholder fields presented as real data.
Confirm upstream failures map to stable internal error responses without leaking provider details.
